scope: Source and archived-healthy review only; no JVM, fault trial, or checklist edit
decision: Existing unmodified MiniCluster JUnit reaches the exact check intermittently. A physical ZooKeeper read with an internal retry is a source-backed pretarget fault-door candidate, but it is absent from the current case site file and has no observed causal-door admission receipt.
source_evidence: TestProcedureManager.java:41-51 starts a two-RS MiniCluster with SimpleMasterProcedureManager and SimpleRSProcedureManager; :60-66 calls Admin.execProcedureWithReturn and checks returned data.

SimpleMasterProcedureManager.java:66-72 installs ZKProcedureCoordinator; :81-102 starts the procedure and waits for completion. ProcedureCoordinator.java:162-167 submits it to a worker; Procedure.java:190-208 calls sendGlobalBarrierReached after the acquire latch.

ZKProcedureMemberRpcs.java:265-278 writes a PB-prefixed completion child. ZKProcedureCoordinator.java:119-127 reaches the selected check only when watchAndCheckExists sees that child during the synchronous scan and getData returns nonempty data. A later child is handled at the distinct callback check at :208-211.

TestZKProcedureControllers.java:213 calls sendGlobalBarrierReached before :216-218 posts member completion, so that original direct-controller selector does not naturally reach @127. Its callback is not the selected check.

Physical candidate hook: RecoverableZooKeeper.getData(String,Watcher,Stat) @405, callee org.apache.zookeeper.ZooKeeper#getData(String,Watcher,Stat), inject KeeperException.ConnectionLossException. ZKUtil.java:340-345 calls this read from ZKProcedureCoordinator.java:124, immediately before @127. RecoverableZooKeeper.java:397-423 retries CONNECTIONLOSS; :119-132 configures three retries by default. A transient single fault followed by a successful read can continue to @127. An exhausted fault is rethrown by ZKWatcher.java:710-712 and exits this invocation before @127, so it cannot be counted as the selected @131 throw.

Current Mallory/cases/HBASE-23.sites.json selects RpcServer.call @447 IOException, not the ZooKeeper read. The archived exact-hit seed has no observed causal path door because its procedure worker region starts at root without a submit/claim edge.
